 NBA 2026 Regular Season 
 Los Angeles Lakers 114 – 108 Live Detroit Pistons Live Updated a few seconds ago Lakers vs Pistons LIVE, Score Updates and Play-by-Play in NBA (113-107)
 Follow Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons live score on NBA TV at Little Caesars Arena: Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler, Cade Cunningham and Ausar Thompson starting lineups, box score stats & play-by-play in the 2026-27 NBA season on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Carlos Bernal Updated November 8, 2026, 8:33 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 8:33 PM ET 8:31 PM ET 2 minutes ago Q4 (0:32) Austin Reaves drills a 27-foot triple for 39 points before Kevin Huerter answers from deep!
 Paul Reed tips in his eighth offensive rebound of the night at 1:06 (109-104) before Detroit loses its coach's challenge and is charged with a timeout. On the ensuing possession, Austin Reaves steps back and buries a cold-blooded 27-foot three-pointer with 45.6 seconds left to reach 39 points and make it 112-104! Detroit refuses to quit: after Ziaire Williams blocks Daniss Jenkins' perimeter attempt, Cade Cunningham corrals the loose ball and Kevin Huerter splashes a 27-foot three-pointer with 32.4 seconds remaining to cut it to 112-107!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 Key moments
 7:58 PM ET Q4 (11:17) Fourth quarter underway with Reaves… 
 7:27 PM ET Q3 (11:06) Second half underway as Austin… 
 7:08 PM ET Halftime in Detroit: Lakers 61, Pistons 48… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 8:27 PM ET 6 minutes ago Q4 (1:10) Ziaire Williams throws down a dunk off a Walker Kessler pass as the Lakers lead 109-102!
 Walker Kessler converts his bonus free throw at 2:15 to complete the three-point play (107-99) before Duncan Robinson answers with a 25-foot three-pointer assisted by Kevin Huerter to keep Detroit's hopes alive at 107-102. On the ensuing possession, Kessler turns playmaker out of the post, finding a cutting Ziaire Williams for an emphatic two-handed dunk at 1:33 (16 points for Williams) to restore a seven-point Lakers lead at 109-102 entering the final minute!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:23 PM ET 10 minutes ago Q4 (2:15) Walker Kessler dominates the glass for a double-double and-one to make it 106-99!
 Duncan Robinson briefly brings Detroit back within three on a 25-foot triple assisted by Cade Cunningham at 3:17 (102-99), prompting a Lakers timeout. Out of the break, Austin Reaves calmly sinks two free throws to reach 36 points (7-of-7 FT), and Walker Kessler takes over on the glass! Kessler secures a defensive rebound on a Daniss Jenkins three-point miss, tracks down the offensive board on Collin Sexton's perimeter attempt at 2:17, and powers up for a putback layup and the foul on Paul Reed at 2:15 to notch a double-double (11 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks) and stretch the Lakers lead to 106-99!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:19 PM ET 14 minutes ago Q4 (3:32) Ziaire Williams buries a clutch three-pointer to push the Lakers lead to 102-96!
 Cade Cunningham picks up his fifth personal foul with 4:58 remaining, joining Duncan Robinson in foul trouble for Detroit. Ausar Thompson grabs his 11th rebound and goes coast-to-coast for a running layup at 4:23 to cut the margin back to one (97-96), but Ziaire Williams delivers a massive dagger from 26 feet off an Austin Reaves pass for his fourth triple of the night (14 points). After Jarred Vanderbilt pulls down his 10th rebound on a Duncan Robinson miss, Jake LaRavia sinks two free throws at 3:32 to put Los Angeles up 102-96!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:15 PM ET 18 minutes ago Q4 (4:58) JJ Redick wins coach's challenge, Reaves scores inside and Walker Kessler rejects a dunk!
 Huge sequence for the Lakers on both ends of the floor! JJ Redick challenges the out-of-bounds call at 6:04 and wins the review to retain possession for Los Angeles. Walker Kessler and Austin Reaves battle on the offensive glass before Reaves follows his own miss with a putback layup at 5:42 to reach 34 points and make it 97-94. On the other end, after Daniss Jenkins tracks down two offensive rebounds for Detroit, Walker Kessler rises up at the rim to reject Ausar Thompson's dunk attempt at 5:03!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:11 PM ET 23 minutes ago Q4 (6:04) Paul Reed floater pulls Detroit within 95-94 with possession to take the lead!
 Coming out of the timeout, Jake LaRavia splits a pair of free throws for Los Angeles as Daniss Jenkins and Duncan Robinson check back in for the Pistons. Detroit keeps an offensive rebound alive on a Kevin Huerter drive, and Paul Reed checks into the game and immediately converts a 4-foot floater off a Duncan Robinson inbound pass at 6:31. After Austin Reaves misses an 18-foot step-back jumper at 6:06, Detroit secures the defensive rebound trailing 95-94 with a chance to take its first lead of the night!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:06 PM ET 27 minutes ago Q4 (6:59) Javonte Green answers from deep after baskets by Walker Kessler and Collin Sexton!
 Every possession feels like playoff basketball down the stretch in Detroit! Kevin Huerter swats Walker Kessler's initial reverse layup attempt, but Kessler corrals his own offensive rebound and scores on the putback. Collin Sexton then grabs consecutive defensive boards and races coast-to-coast for a running layup to make it 94-89, only for Cade Cunningham to kick it out to Javonte Green for a 26-foot three-pointer at 7:20. With 6:59 left on the clock and the Lakers ahead 94-92, J.B. Bickerstaff calls a timeout after a shooting foul on Green.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 8:02 PM ET 31 minutes ago Q4 (8:43) One-point game in Detroit as Daniss Jenkins and Cade Cunningham cut it to 90-89!
 We have a one-point ballgame at Little Caesars Arena! Ronald Holland II knocks down two free throws, Kevin Huerter comes up with another steal, and Cade Cunningham sets up Daniss Jenkins for a 23-foot transition three-pointer, his eighth triple of the night to give him 28 points. After Collin Sexton scores a layup off a Quentin Grimes pass, Holland feeds Cunningham for a two-handed dunk and Cunningham splits a pair at the line at 9:14 to bring Detroit within 90-89 as Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler check back in for the Lakers!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:58 PM ET 35 minutes ago Q4 (11:17) Fourth quarter underway with Reaves at 32 points and Detroit within striking distance
 The fourth quarter is underway at Little Caesars Arena! With Duncan Robinson sitting on five personal fouls, J.B. Bickerstaff sends Ronald Holland II onto the floor alongside Cade Cunningham, Kevin Huerter (19 points, 7-10 FG), Daniss Jenkins (25 points, 7-11 3PT) and John Collins. Adou Thiero and John Collins trade defensive rebounds on early perimeter misses from Huerter and Collin Sexton as the Lakers look to protect their lead behind Austin Reaves (32 points) and double-digit rebounder Walker Kessler (10 rebounds).
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:54 PM ET 39 minutes ago End of Q3: Lakers 88, Pistons 81 as Collin Sexton halts an 11-0 Detroit surge
 What a third quarter in Detroit! Coming out of the timeout, the Pistons force a 24-second shot-clock violation and Kevin Huerter finishes a layup off a Duncan Robinson dish at 1:03 to cap an 11-0 run and pull Detroit within three points at 84-81. Collin Sexton finally steadies the Lakers in the closing minute, scoring a layup off a Jarred Vanderbilt feed at 0:45 and knocking down two free throws with 18.6 seconds left after drawing Duncan Robinson's fifth personal foul. We head to the fourth quarter with Los Angeles clinging to an 88-81 lead!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:50 PM ET 43 minutes ago Q3 (1:38) Pistons reel off a 9-0 run to cut the Lakers lead to five!
 Little Caesars Arena is rocking! With Austin Reaves taking a breather on the bench, Detroit's perimeter pressure completely flips the game in 52 seconds. Javonte Green strips Jarred Vanderbilt for a breakaway dunk, Kevin Huerter pushes the pace in transition to set up Duncan Robinson for a running dunk, and Huerter steals the ball from Quentin Grimes before finishing a fast-break layup off an Ausar Thompson feed. A once 26-point Lakers lead is down to 84-79, forcing JJ Redick to call another timeout!
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:46 PM ET an hour ago Q3 (2:30) Duncan Robinson buries a second-chance triple to force a JJ Redick timeout!
 Collin Sexton threads a bounce pass to Jarred Vanderbilt for a layup inside that draws Cade Cunningham's fourth personal foul, sending Cunningham to the bench. Moments later, Kevin Huerter comes up with a steal and Javonte Green tracks down an offensive rebound to kick it back out to Duncan Robinson, who drills his first three-pointer of the night from 24 feet to cut the Lakers lead to 84-73 and prompt a full timeout from JJ Redick.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:42 PM ET an hour ago Q3 (3:51) Daniss Jenkins hits his seventh three-pointer as Detroit trims the deficit to 12
 Coming out of the timeout, Detroit puts together a spirited push. Daniss Jenkins strips the ball in the lane to spark a fast break that ends with Kevin Huerter feeding John Collins for a dunk, and moments later Jenkins buries his seventh three-pointer of the night from 24 feet to reach 25 points. Sandro Mamukelashvili and Walker Kessler answer inside for Los Angeles, with Kessler cleaning up a blocked shot for a putback before Huerter hits two free throws to make it 82-70 Lakers.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:35 PM ET an hour ago Q3 (6:30) Austin Reaves banks in a deep triple to reach 32 points!
 Austin Reaves is putting on an absolute clinic in Detroit. After Kevin Huerter and Javonte Green convert in the lane off Daniss Jenkins passes for the Pistons, Reaves answers with an 11-foot step-back jumper, a 10-foot turnaround fadeaway, and a 26-foot banked three-pointer over the outstretched contest to give him 32 points on the night and stretch the Lakers lead to 78-61.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:31 PM ET an hour ago Q3 (8:59) Walker Kessler reverse dunk and Austin Reaves three-point play
 Walker Kessler anchors the interior on both ends of the floor, swatting Paul Reed's layup attempt before throwing down a two-handed reverse dunk in traffic. Moments later, Matisse Thybulle floats in a 7-footer in the lane, and after Cade Cunningham hits his first field goal of the night from beyond the arc, Austin Reaves attacks the basket for an and-one layup to make it 71-53 Los Angeles.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:27 PM ET an hour ago Q3 (11:06) Second half underway as Austin Reaves strikes from deep!
 The third quarter is underway at Little Caesars Arena! Austin Reaves picks up right where he left off before the break, burying a deep 29-foot three-pointer off a Quentin Grimes assist on the opening possession. Matisse Thybulle then records his fourth steal of the night before Ausar Thompson follows his own miss with a tip-in at the rim for Detroit (64-50).
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:16 PM ET an hour ago Halftime Box Score Breakdown: Reaves and Jenkins duel at 22 points apiece
 Through two quarters in Detroit, the Lakers are shooting an efficient 50% from the floor (23-of-46 FG) and 50% from three-point range (7-of-14 3PT) while dominating the interior with 30 points in the paint to Detroit's 10. Austin Reaves (22 points, 4-4 FT), Quentin Grimes (12 points, 3 assists) and Ziaire Williams (11 points, 3-6 3PT) lead Los Angeles, while Daniss Jenkins has single-handedly kept the Pistons within striking distance with 22 points on 6-of-7 shooting from beyond the arc alongside 8 rebounds apiece from Paul Reed and Ausar Thompson.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:08 PM ET an hour ago Halftime in Detroit: Lakers 61, Pistons 48 after a wild shooting display
 What a finish to the first half at Little Caesars Arena! Daniss Jenkins catches fire in the closing three minutes, draining four three-pointers assisted by Cade Cunningham, including a 27-footer with 1.1 seconds remaining, to cap a 34-point second quarter for Detroit. Austin Reaves answers right back with a 25-foot triple and three free throws in the final 90 seconds as Los Angeles carries a 61-48 advantage into the locker room.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:58 PM ET 2 hours ago Q2 (3:45) Austin Reaves and Ziaire Williams restore a 19-point cushion
 Every time Detroit threatens to cut the deficit to single digits, JJ Redick's offense finds an immediate counter. Quentin Grimes sets up Austin Reaves for an 8-foot jumper and the foul before feeding Ziaire Williams in the corner for his third triple of the half, and Reaves finishes at the rim to push the Lakers back ahead 53-34.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:52 PM ET 2 hours ago Q2 (5:02) Daniss Jenkins sparks a 7-0 Pistons run off the bench
 J.B. Bickerstaff gets a huge lift from his second unit midway through the second quarter. Guard Daniss Jenkins threads a pass inside to John Collins for a layup, knocks down a pair of free throws, and drills a 26-foot step-back three-pointer to trim the Lakers lead to 45-33 and bring the Detroit crowd to its feet.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:44 PM ET 2 hours ago Q2 (8:28) Adou Thiero throws down a dunk after Pistons perimeter barrage
 Detroit's perimeter shooting finally comes alive in the second period as Kevin Huerter connects on his third triple of the half off a Duncan Robinson feed and rookie forward Ronald Holland II buries a 26-footer. Los Angeles answers inside with a Collin Sexton layup assisted by Walker Kessler and an emphatic two-handed dunk from Adou Thiero (45-26).
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:38 PM ET 2 hours ago Q2 (10:37) Walker Kessler scores inside before Huerter and Jenkins answer from deep
 Walker Kessler opens the second quarter with a finish in the paint to give the Lakers a 26-point cushion at 40-14, but Detroit responds with back-to-back three-pointers from Daniss Jenkins and Kevin Huerter to get its offense moving (40-20).
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:32 PM ET 2 hours ago End of Q1: Lakers 38, Pistons 14 after a dominant opening period
 Los Angeles closes out a lopsided first quarter in style! Ziaire Williams throws down a driving dunk off a Jarred Vanderbilt feed, Quentin Grimes scores on a fast-break layup, and Williams beats the horn with a 26-foot three-pointer assisted by Collin Sexton with 11 seconds left. The Lakers lead 38-14 after holding Detroit to 14 points in the opening frame.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:24 PM ET 2 hours ago Q1 (3:16) Lakers bench erupts as Mamukelashvili and Ziaire Williams stretch the lead
 JJ Redick goes to his bench and the Lakers don't miss a beat. Sandro Mamukelashvili drains a 25-foot three-pointer off an Austin Reaves pass, Quentin Grimes finishes a running layup in transition, Ziaire Williams splashes a triple from Jarred Vanderbilt, and Collin Sexton attacks the rim to give Los Angeles a commanding 28-9 advantage.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Q1 (5:42) Austin Reaves controls the midrange pace for Los Angeles
 John Collins gets Detroit on the board from beyond the arc with a 26-foot jumper off an Ausar Thompson pass, but Austin Reaves answers immediately with consecutive 11-foot pull-up and fadeaway jumpers in the lane before Paul Reed converts a layup inside (18-9).
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:11 PM ET 2 hours ago Q1 (8:09) Quentin Grimes catches fire as the Lakers reel off a 10-0 run!
 Los Angeles seizes early control at Little Caesars Arena! Jake LaRavia slices to the basket off an Austin Reaves assist, Reaves hits a 6-foot fadeaway, and Quentin Grimes drills back-to-back perimeter jumpers, including a 27-foot step-back three, to push the Lakers ahead 14-4 and force J.B. Bickerstaff to talk things over.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:03 PM ET 3 hours ago Q1 (12:00) Tip-off at Little Caesars Arena!
 We are underway in Detroit! Walker Kessler and Paul Reed jump at center court, and Austin Reaves opens the scoring for the Lakers with a driving layup at 11:12. Ausar Thompson answers with a putback tip-in at the rim, Matisse Thybulle finishes a layup off a Kessler feed, and Paul Reed knots the score at 4-4 in the opening two minutes.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:58 PM ET 3 hours ago Confirmed Starting Lineups for Lakers vs Pistons at Little Caesars Arena!
 The official starting fives are in from Detroit! With Luka Doncic sidelined, head coach JJ Redick sends out Austin Reaves, Quentin Grimes, Matisse Thybulle, Jake LaRavia and Walker Kessler for the Los Angeles Lakers. For the Detroit Pistons, with Jalen Duren out, J.B. Bickerstaff starts Cade Cunningham, Ausar Thompson, Duncan Robinson, John Collins and Paul Reed .
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:56 PM ET 3 hours ago Follow Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons Live Score with VAVEL!
 We'll soon be sharing the starting lineups for the Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons game live, along with the latest information coming from Little Caesars Arena. Don't miss a single detail of VAVEL's live game updates and commentary.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:49 PM ET 3 hours ago Detroit Pistons aim to lead their conference!
 Detroit comes into this game against the Lakers with a record of 6 wins and 2 losses in the upper tier of the Eastern Conference. Head coach J.B. Bickerstaff's active rotation is led by Cade Cunningham (24.0 PPG, 7.6 APG), rebounding leader Ausar Thompson (8.6 RPG), John Collins, Ronald Holland II, Kevin Huerter and Duncan Robinson.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:19 PM ET 3 hours ago Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler lead the Lakers rotation in Detroit!
 While Lakers superstar Luka Doncic leads the NBA at 40.1 points and 7.7 assists per game, he is listed as Out on tonight's injury report, putting the spotlight on Austin Reaves, Collin Sexton, Quentin Grimes and rebounding leader Walker Kessler (10.4 RPG) under head coach JJ Redick.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 4:47 PM ET 4 hours ago Pistons Absences!
 According to the official NBA injury report for tonight's game at Little Caesars Arena, Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren (Out) and guard Isaiah Joe (Out) are sidelined, elevating Ausar Thompson (8.6 RPG), John Collins and Paul Reed in the frontcourt rotation.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 4:07 PM ET 4 hours ago Cade Cunningham, the Pistons' player to watch!
 Detroit point guard Cade Cunningham paces the Pistons with 24.0 points and 7.6 assists per game in the 2026-27 NBA season. With Jalen Duren sidelined, Cunningham's two-man game with John Collins, Ausar Thompson (8.6 RPG) and perimeter sharpshooters Duncan Robinson and Kevin Huerter will be crucial tonight.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 3:26 PM ET 5 hours ago Lakers Absences!
 On the official Los Angeles Lakers injury report ahead of tip-off in Detroit, leading scorer Luka Doncic (40.1 PPG, 7.7 APG) is listed as Out, while Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler (10.4 RPG), Collin Sexton, Quentin Grimes, Jarred Vanderbilt, Jake LaRavia and Bronny James are available for head coach JJ Redick.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 3:00 PM ET 6 hours ago How to watch Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons Live Stream, TV Channel & Kick-off Times
 Here are the official kick-off times, TV channels and live stream options to watch Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons in NBA 2026 across major English-speaking regions:

 For real-time Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons live score updates , confirmed starting lineups, match stats and minute-by-minute commentary, follow VAVEL right here.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 3:00 PM ET 6 hours ago Los Angeles Lakers, ready to fight for the title!
 The Lakers enter tonight's matchup against the Pistons with an 8-2 record near the top of the Western Conference, backed by interior anchor Walker Kessler (10.4 RPG), Austin Reaves, Collin Sexton and Quentin Grimes.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 3:00 PM ET 6 hours ago Where is the game?
 Little Caesars Arena in Detroit will host this regular season game between two teams looking to continue their preparations for the 2026-2027 NBA season in their respective conferences. The arena has a capacity of 20,300 and was inaugurated in 2017.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 3:00 PM ET 6 hours ago Hello to all VAVEL readers!
 Welcome to the live broadcast of the Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons game, part of the 2026-2027 NBA Regular Season. The game will take place at Little Caesars Arena. My name is Carlos, and I'll be your host for this game. We'll bring you pre-game analysis, score updates, and live news right here on VAVEL. Follow our live coverage for confirmed starting lineups, injury reports, quarter-by-quarter score updates, player box score stats and standings .
